THE SAME BORROW IS SCALED TWICE. market computes `scaled-debt-added` via `convert-to-scaled-debt asset-id amount true` from the cached `index`, while the vault independently computes `scaled-amount` via `mul-div-up amount INDEX-PRECISION idx` from its own `index` inside `system-borrow`. Both claim to represent the same principal. Show a case where the cached index and the live index differ, or the two roundings differ, so the user's recorded obligation and the vault's recorded receivable are not the same number, and repeat it to open a gap.'
